paragraphs.source_en: He jerks back his hand. He is fast.

units.source_en: He jerks back his hand.
He is fast.
I am faster.

paragraphs.source_en: I bury my dagger through his hand, pinning it to the table.

units.source_en: I bury my dagger through his hand, pinning it to the table.

paragraphs.source_en: His mouth gasps open at the pain. Some weird sort of feral exhalation hisses from his mouth as he jerks at the dagger. But I am bigger than him and I drove the dagger four inches into the table. I hammer it down with a flagon. He can’t pull it out. I lean back and watch him try. There’s something primal to his initial frenzied panic. Then something decidedly human in his recovery, which seems more brutally cold than my act of violence. He calms himself faster than anyone I’ve ever seen. It takes a breath, maybe three, and he leans back in his chair as though we were at drinks.

units.source_en: His mouth gasps open at the pain.
Some weird sort of feral exhalation hisses from his mouth as he jerks at the dagger.
But I am bigger than him and I drove the dagger four inches into the table.
I hammer it down with a flagon.
He can’t pull it out.
I lean back and watch him try.
There’s something primal to his initial frenzied panic.
Then something decidedly human in his recovery, which seems more brutally cold than my act of violence.
He calms himself faster than anyone I’ve ever seen.
It takes a breath, maybe three, and he leans back in his chair as though we were at drinks.
“Well, shit,” he says tightly.

paragraphs.source_en: “I thought we should become better acquainted,” I say. I point to myself. “Jackal, I am Reaper.”

units.source_en: “I thought we should become better acquainted,” I say.
I point to myself.
“Jackal, I am Reaper.”

paragraphs.source_en: “You’ve the better name,” he replies. He takes a breath. Another. “How long have you known?”

units.source_en: “You’ve the better name,” he replies.
He takes a breath.
Another.
“How long have you known?”

paragraphs.source_en: “That you were the Jackal? A hopeful guess. That you were up to no good? Before I entered the castle. No one surrenders without a fight. One of your rings didn’t fit. And hide your hands next time. Insecure sobs always hide or fiddle with their hands. But really you had no chance. The Proctors knew I was coming here. They thought to make it a trap to ruin me by telling you I was coming. So you would sneak in here, try to catch me with my pants down. Their mistake. Your mistake.”

paragraphs.source_en: And so she wouldn’t accidentally ask why we were pretending to be drunk on grape juice.

paragraphs.source_en: Pax will have found their hiding place. Thunder still rolls. I hope the Jackal sank a large size of his force into this ambush. If he didn’t, it’ll be a hassle, because if he has Jupiter’s castle, he probably has Jupiter’s army, which has Juno and much of Vulcan, and soon Mars’s. His army will be twice the size of mine and we will be the only two left. But I have him here.
